# Auralane 1.0.3

This release adds true multi-account support, makes new versions visible without permanently occupying the sidebar, and completes the blue-teal Auralane visual refresh.

## Highlights

- Save up to eight YouTube Music accounts on one device and switch between them from the account menu at any time.
- Check GitHub Releases automatically whenever the packaged app starts.
- Show a red dot beside **Settings** when an update is available.
- Show a compact, dismissible **New release** notice when Settings is outside the visible sidebar area.
- Refresh the application icon with transparent rounded corners across the title bar, taskbar, Windows packages, macOS packages, and Linux assets.

## New features

### Multiple accounts on one device

- Added a compact account switcher to the top bar.
- Added isolated sign-in sessions so **Add account** never silently reuses the active account.
- Stored every saved account session with the operating system's encrypted credential storage.
- Synchronized the selected account with YouTube Music web fallback playback as well as API requests.
- Cleared account-specific playback streams, likes, library data, playlists, and history when switching accounts.
- Made **Forget account** remove only the active account while preserving other saved accounts.
- Added validation and rollback when a saved account has expired or cannot be loaded.

### Release notifications

- Added an automatic GitHub Release check on every packaged-app launch.
- Added a Settings notification dot that does not change navigation alignment.
- Added a small **New release** sidebar notice only while Settings is outside the visible scroll area.
- Added a close button that dismisses the notice for that release only; a later version appears again.
- Clicking the notice opens the GitHub updates section directly.
- Removed the permanent **New** label from the GitHub updates heading.

## Fixes and improvements

- Improved floating-lyrics contrast by constraining artwork-derived accent colors to a readable brightness.
- Increased the floating-lyrics panel contrast on bright windows and removed completed-letter shadows.
- Made the **Browse** row scroll naturally with the sidebar instead of remaining stuck over navigation items.
- Replaced the old hard-coded title-bar mark with the current Auralane icon.
- Corrected transparent icon corners so the title bar and operating-system surfaces show the intended rounded shape.
- Added regression checks for encrypted account storage, isolated sign-in sessions, web-playback account switching, update notifications, and launch-time update checks.
- Updated all supported interface translations for the new account and update controls.
- Verified the dependency tree with no known high-severity production vulnerabilities.

## Downloads

Choose the file for your device. The files under **Update metadata** are used by Auralane automatically and are not applications.

### Windows 10/11, Intel or AMD 64-bit

| File | Use |
| --- | --- |
| `Auralane-Setup-1.0.3-x64.exe` | **Recommended.** Installs Auralane and supports one-click automatic updates. |
| `Auralane-Portable-1.0.3-x64.exe` | Runs without installation. Use this when you cannot or do not want to install the app. |

Windows on ARM is not currently published as a native build.

### macOS Apple silicon

For Macs with an Apple M1, M2, M3, M4, or newer Apple chip:

| File | Use |
| --- | --- |
| `Auralane-1.0.3-arm64.dmg` | **Recommended** Apple silicon disk image. |
| `Auralane-1.0.3-arm64.zip` | Archive for manual extraction. |

### macOS Intel

For Macs whose **About This Mac** screen lists an Intel processor:

| File | Use |
| --- | --- |
| `Auralane-1.0.3-x64.dmg` | **Recommended** Intel Mac disk image. |
| `Auralane-1.0.3-x64.zip` | Archive for manual extraction. |

### Update metadata - do not download manually

- `latest.yml` and `latest-mac.yml` tell the built-in updater which release is current.
- `.blockmap` files allow supported updates to download only changed blocks.
- `SHA256SUMS-windows.txt`, `SHA256SUMS-macos-arm64.txt`, and `SHA256SUMS-macos-x64.txt` contain checksums for verifying downloads.
- GitHub's automatically generated **Source code** archives are for developers, not normal installation.

## Updating

Installed Windows builds check this release automatically. Open **Settings > GitHub updates** and select **Update now** to download, install, and reopen Auralane. Portable and unsigned macOS builds should be replaced manually with the matching file above.

Your saved accounts, preferences, queue, local playlists, lyrics choices, and downloads remain in the existing Auralane data directory during a normal update.

> Auralane is an independent, unofficial client and is not affiliated with Google or YouTube. Current packages are unsigned, so Windows SmartScreen or macOS Gatekeeper may show a first-run warning.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/adam10000423-oss/Auralane/compare/v1.0.2...v1.0.3
